proposal.summary: A vulnerability in the DNS functionality of Cisco Nexus Dashboard Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a denial of service (DoS) condition.
proposal.cwe_quote: This vulnerability is due to the improper processing of DNS requests.

AV.quote: An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a continuous stream of DNS requests to an affected device.

A.quote: A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the coredns service to stop working or cause the device to reload, resulting in a DoS condition.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate the DNS request handling in the affected software version.
